evals.prompt: Our inventory app looks dated. Redesign it to a modern SaaS look with a left sidebar instead of the top nav. For now only do the app shell and the Dashboard (Overview) page.
evals.expected_output: Top nav replaced by a left sidebar with all existing routes and a clear active state; header widgets (language switcher, profile menu, filter bar) relocated; Dashboard restyled with tokens; existing palette kept; no logic, route or i18n key changes; build passes.
assertions: Top nav bar replaced by a left sidebar nav (aside/sidebar element in the app shell)
All 6 existing nav routes still linked from the shell (/, /inventory, /orders, /spending, /demand, /reports)
Active nav state follows the route (aria-current or active class bound to the route)
No new dependencies (package.json unchanged)
No data-layer or routing changes (api.js, composables, main.js untouched)
Every translation key used in changed templates exists in both en.js and ja.js
Palette kept: at most 3 hex colors added that the app did not already use
No emojis added to the UI
Production build passes
